patient_profile.diagnosis_summary: Adult female with obesity, baseline BMI 41.48.

request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for Wegovy for chronic weight management

denial_rationale: Insurer denied Wegovy, stating the submitted records did not establish enrollment in a qualified comprehensive weight management program for at least 3 months with physician-office counseling.

known_facts.text: Patient has obesity with baseline BMI 41.48.
Patient has been taking Wegovy samples; current BMI is 37.88.
Patient previously tried and failed Ozempic.
Patient engaged in behavioral modification and dietary restriction for at least 3 months without achieving desired weight loss.
Patient reports using a weight loss app, having a gym membership, and being referred to a weight loss clinic.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: Behavioral modification and dietary restriction trial; desired weight loss not achieved.
Use of a weight loss tracking app; referral to a weight loss clinic; gym membership reported.
Taking Wegovy via samples; BMI decreased from 41.48 to 37.88 during this period.

available_evidence.description: Documentation of BMI values before and during sample use
Documentation of Ozempic trial and outcome
Records of weight-loss-app use, gym membership, and clinic referral
Evidence of enrollment in a qualified comprehensive weight management program with physician-office counseling for >=3 months

unknowns: The plan's specific definition/criteria for a 'qualified comprehensive weight management program.'
Whether the weight loss clinic referral resulted in an actual enrolled, ongoing program with office-based counseling.
